title: docs(skills): the AI skill stops teaching an agent's model.provider
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuNTptyd1j97p7dHXZLEeH2g)_

Fixes #37796

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：照我们技能包写应用的 AI 助手，以后在代理的模型配置里只写模型名，不再写“提供方”这一项；想用哪家提供方，到部署的 AI 设置里打开。
- 为什么做：“提供方”这一项今天已经退役，写了会被平台拒收，而对外发布的技能页还在教它；这是那次退役欠下的技能页跟进。
- 出错会怎样：只改教学文字和一道评测题，运行时不变；最坏是 AI 助手照旧文字给出过时写法，把文字改回即可撤回。
- 要你做什么：这是对外发布的技能包，需要你批准后才能合并。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, Model Configuration.** The `provider` row leaves the agent model table. The paragraph above the table now says the `model` block names a model and never a provider: the deployment's AI settings choose the provider and match the model name among the providers turned on, and a written `provider` is a parse error whose fix is to delete the key (retired in protocol 19). The `model`, `temperature` and `maxTokens` / `topP` rows are untouched.
- **The schema citation in the same paragraph** moves from `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts:37-45` to `:87-95`. PR #37783 added 50 lines above the key list, so the old range pointed into a comment block. `:87` is the `provider` tombstone and `:95` is `topP`.
- **`skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`, case 2.** The prompt is unchanged: a copilot that should use Anthropic at temperature 0.3 with a 2000-token cap. The expected answer now writes no provider key, puts sampling under `model`, names the model in the free-string `model` or leaves it to the host's default, and sends the choice of Anthropic to the deployment's AI settings. `must_contain` goes from `provider`, `anthropic`, `temperature`, `maxTokens` to `temperature`, `maxTokens`, `deployment`. `must_not_contain` goes from empty to the written line `provider: 'anthropic',`.
- **`.changeset/37796-skills-agent-model-provider-retired.md`**: one `@objectstack/skills` patch.
- **`.changeset/37711-skills-agent-model-optional.md`**: a DELIBERATE CORRECTION, declared below.

## Why

PR #37783 (merge `f07d63a5`) retired an agent's `model.provider`. The published skill still listed the key with its enum, and eval case 2 graded an answer as correct only when it wrote `provider`. An AI that follows the skill would write a key the platform now refuses.

The Model Registry's own provider list (`ModelProviderSchema`) is a live key and this PR does not describe it. Its only mention in the bundle was inside the removed row.

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION

`Check Changeset` is red on purpose: this PR edits a pending release note it did not add, `.changeset/37711-skills-agent-model-optional.md` (from PR #37765). That note ships in the same release as this change, and two of its sentences would be false on release day.

Title, before:

> docs(skills): an agent's model name and provider are optional

Title, after:

> docs(skills): an agent's model name is optional

Body, before:

> `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` (Model Configuration) now teaches that `model.model` is optional, and that an agent without one runs on the host's default model for the environment, and that `model.provider` is optional with no default (the deployment's choice) instead of defaulting to `openai`. The inline enum list is unchanged, and the schema citation now points at `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts:37-45`. The `objectstack-ai` eval case on sampling settings accepts an omitted `model` and states the provider has no default. Published prose only: it teaches the optional `model` / `provider` already on main since #37697.

Body, after:

> `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` (Model Configuration) now teaches that `model.model` is optional, and that an agent without one runs on the host's default model for the environment. It no longer says `model.provider` defaults to `openai`; the key itself leaves the page in the same release (see the changeset on the skill no longer teaching `model.provider`). The `objectstack-ai` eval case on sampling settings accepts an omitted `model`. Published prose only: it teaches the optional `model` already on main since #37697.

The note's last sentence (the token budget) is unchanged. The precedent is PR #37783 itself, which corrected `.changeset/37686-agent-model-name-optional.md` the same way.

## Tests

### Skill eval run (recorded)

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --skills objectstack-ai --repeats 3 --concurrency 4`, on head `fb8b3f20`. 12 cases, 2 arms, 3 repeats: 72 of 72 turns ran in 8 min, none out of the denominator. Subscription login, no API key, CLI 2.1.332, the login's default model and effort.

| case | with-skill | no-skill |
|:--|--:|--:|
| **case 2 (this PR)** | **3/3** | **0/3** |
| bundle, all 12 cases | 30/36 (83%) | 1/36 (3%) |

Case 2, read answer by answer: all three with-skill answers put `temperature` and `maxTokens` under `model`, write no provider key, and send Anthropic to the deployment's AI settings. All three no-skill answers write `provider: 'anthropic',` inside the `model` block, which is the refused spelling.

<details>
<summary>Per-case table, round 2 (head fb8b3f20)</summary>

| case | with-skill | no-skill | with-skill missed | with-skill carried forbidden |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|:--|
| #1 | 3/3 | 1/3 |  |  |
| #2 | 3/3 | 0/3 |  |  |
| #3 | 3/3 | 0/3 |  |  |
| #4 | 3/3 | 0/3 |  |  |
| #5 | 2/3 | 0/3 | `aiExposed` |  |
| #6 | 1/3 | 0/3 | `signed-in session` `refused` |  |
| #7 | 0/3 | 0/3 | `do not retry` |  |
| #8 | 3/3 | 0/3 |  |  |
| #9 | 3/3 | 0/3 |  |  |
| #10 | 3/3 | 0/3 |  |  |
| #11 | 3/3 | 0/3 |  |  |
| #12 | 3/3 | 0/3 |  |  |

</details>

<details>
<summary>Round 1 (head 789e0c74) and why the forbidden token changed</summary>

The first commit graded case 2 with `must_not_contain: ["provider:"]`. Round 1 scored it 1/3 with-skill. The two failing answers were correct: each wrote no provider key and named the retired spelling only to warn against it ("writing `provider: 'anthropic'` now fails to parse"). A bare `provider:` graded that warning as a failure. The second commit narrows the token to the object-literal line `provider: 'anthropic',` (with its trailing comma), which a warning in prose does not carry and every no-skill answer in round 2 does. The three round 1 with-skill answers pass under the final tokens when read by hand.

Round 1's no-skill arm is not a clean baseline for case 2. The turns inherited this container's project-memory variables, and all three no-skill answers quoted the team's notes on the retirement. Round 2 was started with `CLAUDE_COWORK_MEMORY_PATH_OVERRIDE` and `CLAUDE_MEMORY_STORES` unset, and no case 2 answer mentions memory.

</details>

Cases 5, 6 and 7 are not touched by this PR. Their with-skill misses are literal-phrase misses in both rounds and are listed under Acceptance notes.

### Local gates, on head `fb8b3f20`

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 49 families for this diff. `--ran` reconciliation: 49 derived, 48 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun.

- 47 exit 0, among them `check-skills-token-ratchet` (and its self-test), `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-links`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:published-files` and `@objectstack/spec` `check:skill-docs`.
- `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` exit 1: the DELIBERATE CORRECTION above. It names `.changeset/37711-skills-agent-model-optional.md` and nothing else.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, NOT MEASURED: it needs a full `pnpm build`, and this container built only the scenario runner's closure. CI runs it.
- Outside the derived set, also exit 0: `@objectstack/spec` `check:skill-refs` and `check:skill-served-sections`.

### Size readings (`skills/**`)

| reading | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, lines | 485 | 487 |
| `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, tokens | 6801 | 6801 (ceiling 6801, no row moved) |
| all `skills/*/SKILL.md`, lines | 4960 | 4962 |
| `evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`, tokens (measured, not ratcheted) | 3359 | 3411 |
| bundle total, tokens | 301302 | 301354 |

The new sentences in `SKILL.md` are paid for by the deleted row. The bundle total grows by the eval fixture alone.

## Acceptance notes

- The branch is the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-2rm2nh`, not `claude/issue-37796-…`.
- The skill's `description` still lists "configuring an LLM provider" among its triggers. Left as is: a user who asks that is now told where the provider is chosen. Changing it would move when the skill loads, which this card does not ask for.
- `SKILL.md:457` cites `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts:234, :251` for the `agent.tools` / `agent.knowledge` tombstones. Those lines did not hold the tombstones before PR #37783 either, so this PR leaves the citation alone. Noted, not filed.
- Eval cases 6 and 7 miss literal phrases (`signed-in session`, `refused`, `do not retry`) on the with-skill arm in both rounds, case 7 in all six turns. That reads as a grading-token question on those cases, not as something this diff moved. Noted for the seat.
- The eval runner passes its whole environment to each turn, so a round started inside a project container carries that project's memory into both arms. Noted for the seat with the round 1 records as evidence.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, the hunk under `## Model Configuration`: three new sentences that ship to every customer install.
2. `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`, case 2: the token lists.
3. `.changeset/37711-skills-agent-model-optional.md`: the corrected note.

Two-minute check: `sed -n '84,96p' packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts` shows `provider: retiredKey(...)` at `:87` and `topP` at `:95`, the range the skill now cites, and `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md is 6801 tokens (ceiling 6801; headroom 0)`.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (No name added.)
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran. `pnpm lint` is read from CI on this prose-only diff.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` is not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md: lint and the test jobs are read from CI; the rest is done.
